requirements.evidence: Contract is complete: `Queues` has all required properties/methods and view data (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:24-52,54-249), `Serve` has `selectedQueueId`/`mode`/`lastCalledTicketId`/`notice`/`callNext` (app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:27-34,36-129), routes (routes/web.php:59-60), and all lang keys exist in lang/en/ui.php:108-153 and lang/pt_BR/ui.php:108-153. Edge case missed: a client-tampered `mode` is not handled (Serve.php:114).

conventions.evidence: Uses domain actions (`CreateQueue`/`UpdateQueue`/`SetQueueAccess`/`CallNextTicket`), policies via `$this->authorize`, Blade `<x-label>`/`<x-input>`, `{{ }}` escaping, and updates CHANGELOG/docs. Deviations: no `#[Validate]`/`rules()` and no `$this->validate()` on `name`/`renameName` (Queues.php:26,44,72,139); internal helpers are public (Serve.php:49,61,76; Queues.php:221); `grantAccess`/`revokeAccess` skip component-level authorization (Queues.php:205,213).

security.evidence: Every client id is re-resolved scoped (`$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail(...)` at Queues.php:98,123,141,166,180,191,207,216 and Serve.php:111; memberships at Queues.php:208,217), `#[Locked]` on `$entity`/`$lastCalledTicketId` (Serve.php:24,31), `Gate::forUser(...)->allows('call', ...)` filters (Serve.php:57,80), rate limiter (Serve.php:105-125), and Blade escapes with `{{ }}`. Gap: `mode` is unvalidated client input and `CallMode::from($this->mode)` (Serve.php:114) throws `ValueError` on tamper.

tests.evidence: New Pest suites cover list/create/rename/toggle/access, foreign-id tamper, locale/navbar (tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesUiTest.php:1-255) and serve selection/waiting/filter/call/forbidden/locked state (tests/Feature/Entity/ServeUiTest.php:1-189), plus members tab tests (tests/Feature/Entity/MembersTest.php:369-457). Missing: rate-limit test, invalid-`mode` tamper test, and per-action unauthorized tests.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing actions and `<x-label>`/`<x-input>`; no new layer. Some duplication: the ValidationException loop is copied (Queues.php:80-84,149-153) and `$this->reset('name'); $this->name = '';` is redundant (Queues.php:90-91).

readability.evidence: Small, clearly named methods with class/method PHPDoc (Queues.php:22-249, Serve.php:22-138) and sibling-style Blade. The public helper methods blur the component API (Serve.php:49-95); render/Blade blocks are long but straightforward.

scope.evidence: Diff is limited to the queues/serve pages, members tabs, routes, lang, docs and tests; CHANGELOG.md:21 and docs/business-rules.md:101-104 are directly related. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: `mode` is client-writable and never validated; `callNext()` uses `CallMode::from($this->mode)`, which throws an uncaught `ValueError` for any value outside the three modes, turning a tampered request into a 500 (while `waitingTickets()` silently falls back via `tryFrom`).

The public input properties `name` and `renameName` have no `#[Validate]`/`rules()` and `create()`/`rename()` never call `$this->validate()`, contrary to the mandatory Livewire validation policy; the domain actions validate, so data is safe, but the component-side rule is not met.

`grantAccess()`, `revokeAccess()` and `callNext()` delegate authorization entirely to `SetQueueAccess`/`CallNextTicket` and never call `$this->authorize(...)` in the component; the actions/Gate guard them, so impact is limited, but the per-action authorization policy is not met and these paths lack unauthorized-call tests.

`callableQueues()`, `selectedQueue()`, `waitingTickets()` and `viewingQueue()` are only used internally but are public, making them callable Livewire endpoints; they should be `protected`/`private` (helpers are not part of the front-end API).
No test exercises the required 10/min rate limit, and there is no tamper test for an invalid `mode`; the suite therefore does not cover a stated requirement or the resulting 500 path.

Only `mount` is tested for the employee 403; there are no unauthorized-call tests for `openCreate`, `create`, `startRename`, `rename`, `toggleActive`, `grantAccess` or `revokeAccess`, and no assertion that the access modal renders grant/revoke buttons or the manager "can call" tag, contrary to the per-action unauthorized/tamper test policy.
`$this->reset('name')` followed by `$this->name = ''`, and the re-assignment of `mode` in `mount()` although the property already defaults to `'any'`, are redundant.
The tabs have `role="tablist"`/`role="tab"` and `aria-selected`, but the panels lack `role="tabpanel"` and `aria-controls`/`id` linkage, so the tab pattern is incomplete for assistive technology.
All memberships with their users are queried on every render, even when the access modal is closed; this is unnecessary work for a modal-only list.

review.summary: Implements the queues management page, attendant serve panel, members tabs, routes/lang/docs and a substantial Pest suite; the core scoping and security (entity-scoped lookups, locked ticket id, Gate checks, rate limiter) is sound and most task requirements are covered. It needs changes before merge: client-tampered `mode` makes `callNext()` return 500, the components skip the mandatory `#[Validate]`/`$this->validate()` policy and component-level authorization for grant/revoke/callNext, helper methods are exposed as public endpoints, and the rate-limit and per-action unauthorized tests are missing.
